symptom: PC1 can ping its gateway but cannot reach PC2.
topology_note: PC1 and PC2 connect to SW1; PC1 should be VLAN 10 and PC2 VLAN 20.
show_output: show vlan brief: Fa0/1 VLAN 10; Fa0/2 VLAN 10; VLAN 20 exists.
expected_fault: PC2 is assigned to the wrong VLAN; Fa0/2 should be VLAN 20.

symptom: PC in VLAN 20 cannot communicate with any device in VLAN 20.
topology_note: PCs connect to SW1; VLAN 20 is required.
show_output: show vlan brief: VLAN 10 active; VLAN 20 absent.
expected_fault: Required VLAN 20 is missing on the switch.

symptom: Devices in different VLANs cannot communicate through the router.
topology_note: SW1 connects to R1 using a trunk link.
show_output: show interfaces trunk: Fa0/24 not listed as trunk; show vlan brief shows VLANs present.
expected_fault: Switch-to-router link is not configured as a trunk.

symptom: VLAN 30 clients lose connectivity after a trunk change.
topology_note: SW1-SW2 trunk carries VLANs 10
severity: VLAN 30 is not allowed on the trunk.

symptom: PC has an IP address but cannot ping the router.
topology_note: PC: 192.168.10.20/24; gateway configured as 192.168.20.1.
expected_fault: Default gateway is on the wrong subnet.

symptom: PC cannot leave its local subnet.
topology_note: PC is connected to the correct VLAN; router interface provides gateway.
show_output: show ip interface brief: G0/0 192.168.10.1 administratively down.
expected_fault: Gateway interface is administratively down.

symptom: Only one workstation cannot reach remote networks.
topology_note: Other PCs work; affected PC uses 192.168.10.30.
show_output: ipconfig: gateway 192.168.10.254; router gateway is 192.168.10.1.
expected_fault: Affected workstation has an incorrect default gateway.

symptom: New PCs receive 169.254.x.x addresses.
topology_note: PCs are on VLAN 10; DHCP server is on another subnet.
show_output: show ip dhcp pool: no active pool for 192.168.10.0/24.
expected_fault: DHCP scope for VLAN 10 is missing.

symptom: PCs in VLAN 20 receive addresses from the wrong subnet.
topology_note: DHCP server has multiple pools.
show_output: show ip dhcp binding: client receives 192.168.10.x while connected to VLAN 20.
expected_fault: DHCP pool/network mapping is incorrect.

symptom: DHCP clients cannot obtain an address from a remote server.
topology_note: DHCP server is on 10.0.0.10; clients are in 192.168.20.0/24.
show_output: show run interface G0/1: no ip helper-address configured.
expected_fault: DHCP relay is missing on the client gateway interface.

symptom: A DHCP client intermittently fails after address exhaustion.
topology_note: DHCP pool is configured for a small subnet.
show_output: show ip dhcp pool: 2 addresses available; show ip dhcp binding: all usable addresses bound.
expected_fault: DHCP pool has no free addresses.

symptom: PC can ping 8.8.8.8 but cannot open example.com.
topology_note: Internet connectivity works.
show_output: ipconfig: DNS server 192.168.50.99; actual DNS server is 192.168.50.10.
expected_fault: PC is configured with the wrong DNS server.

symptom: Clients can reach the DNS server but names do not resolve.
topology_note: DNS server is reachable.
show_output: Server DNS service: OFF; ping to DNS server succeeds.
expected_fault: DNS service is disabled.

symptom: Only one website hostname fails to resolve.
topology_note: DNS service is running and other names resolve.
show_output: DNS table: no A record for portal.local.
expected_fault: Required DNS record is missing.

symptom: PC can reach its gateway but cannot reach the server network.
topology_note: R1 connects to R2; server is behind R2.
show_output: show ip route on R1: no route to 192.168.30.0/24.
expected_fault: Route to the server network is missing on R1.

symptom: Traffic reaches R2 but replies never return to the client.
topology_note: Two-router topology with static routes.
show_output: show ip route R2: no route to 192.168.10.0/24.
expected_fault: Return route is missing on R2.

symptom: OSPF neighbors are not forming.
topology_note: R1 and R2 are directly connected.
show_output: show ip ospf neighbor: empty; show ip interface brief: R1 G0/1 10.0.12.1/30
osi_layer: OSPF interfaces use mismatched subnet addressing.

symptom: A remote LAN is not advertised by OSPF.
show_output: show ip protocols: network statement does not include 192.168.10.0/24.
expected_fault: OSPF is not enabled for the LAN interface/network.

symptom: Internet-bound traffic fails from all internal PCs.
topology_note: R1 is the edge router.
show_output: show ip route: no 0.0.0.0/0 route.
expected_fault: Default route is missing.

symptom: PC can reach the gateway but cannot reach the web server.
topology_note: R1 connects LAN to server network.
show_output: show access-lists: 110 deny tcp 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 host 192.168.30.10 eq 80.
expected_fault: ACL explicitly denies HTTP traffic.

symptom: SSH to the router is blocked from the management PC.
topology_note: Management subnet should be allowed.
show_output: show access-lists 10: deny 192.168.10.50; permit any.
expected_fault: ACL denies the management PC address.

symptom: Only traffic to one server is blocked.
topology_note: ACL is applied outbound on the router.
show_output: show access-lists: deny ip any host 192.168.30.20.
expected_fault: ACL blocks the destination server.

symptom: A newly created ACL has no effect.
topology_note: ACL exists but traffic is still permitted.
show_output: show ip interface G0/0: no access-group shown.
expected_fault: ACL is not applied to the interface.

symptom: Internal PCs cannot access an external server.
topology_note: R1 connects inside LAN to ISP router.
show_output: show ip nat translations: empty; show run: no ip nat inside/outside.
expected_fault: NAT is not configured on the router interfaces.

symptom: Only one internal subnet can access the internet.
topology_note: Two inside subnets exist.
show_output: show access-lists 1: permit 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255; no permit for 192.168.20.0/24.
expected_fault: NAT ACL does not match the second inside subnet.

symptom: NAT overload is configured but translations do not appear.
topology_note: Inside and outside interfaces are configured.
show_output: show run: ip nat inside source list 1 interface G0/0 overload; show access-lists 1: empty.
expected_fault: NAT ACL has no matching permit statement.

symptom: Users lose internet access after interface renaming/reconfiguration.
topology_note: Router has inside and outside links.
show_output: show run interface G0/1: ip nat inside; G0/0: no ip nat outside.
expected_fault: Outside interface is missing the NAT outside role.

symptom: Laptop connects to Wi-Fi but cannot reach the internal server.
topology_note: AP connects to switch; wireless clients use guest VLAN.
show_output: show vlan brief: guest VLAN 40; server VLAN 10; ACL intended to isolate guests is absent.
expected_fault: Guest isolation/security policy is missing.

symptom: Laptop cannot associate with the wireless network.
topology_note: SSID expected: CampusWiFi.
show_output: AP configuration: SSID Campus-WiFi; laptop profile: CampusWiFi.
expected_fault: SSID mismatch prevents association.

symptom: Wireless clients associate but do not receive DHCP addresses.
topology_note: AP is connected to switch port Fa0/10.
show_output: show vlan brief: Fa0/10 is access VLAN 10; wireless clients should use VLAN 30.
expected_fault: AP switch port is mapped to the wrong VLAN.
